description: Na₃NO₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbca space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.79 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.95 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.59 Å. N is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. All N-O bond lengths are 1.39 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one N atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one N atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to five Na and one N atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one N atom.
